decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - 1.	The Council has not been satisfied that the loss of an employment use can be justified, contrary to policy E.1.5 (Development Involving Loss of or Changes In Employment Uses) of the adopted Unitary Development Plan 2003.

Condition : 3 - 3.	Inadequate turning and manoeuvring space would be available for domestic, visitor, service and emergency vehicles within the site, which would be likely to give rise to conditions prejudicial to the free flow of traffic and general safety of road users on Hounslow Road; contrary to policies ENV-B.1.1 (New development), T.4.3 (Traffic implications of new development) and T.4.4 (Road Safety) of the adopted Unitary Development Plan 2003.

Condition : 4 - 4.	The proposed development would give rise to unreasonable overlooking of neighbouring residential premises contrary to policy ENV-B.1.1 (New development) of the adopted Unitary Development Plan 2003.
description: Outline application for the demolition of the existing warehouse for the erection of a two storey building comprising 4 x two bed flats one x 2 storey building comprising two x 1 bed flats with associated parking and amenity area (Siting, design & appearance)
